body.statement:
From a supplied rational interval name \(\mathfrak r\) for \((p,c_M,c_I,\alpha,G)\), construct a positive rational \(L_J\) and, for every admissible rational interval \(I\subseteq[-G,G]\) and \(m\in\mathbb N\), rational endpoints \(\underline J(I,m)\) and \(\overline J(I,m)\), together with finite checkable evaluation witnesses derived from the piecewise-Gaussian Poisson-energy formulas for \(V_0\) and \(V_\gamma\), such that \((L_J,\mathfrak O)\) satisfies every enclosure, width, and point-width requirement of Definition \(\mathrm{interval\mbox{-}oracle}\) for \(J(p,\gamma)\).  In particular, the construction must certify the explicit uniform modulus
\[
 \overline J(I,m)-\underline J(I,m)
 \leq L_J\operatorname{diam}(I)+2^{-m}
\]
and must not take oracle soundness as an input premise.
body.justification: This open target now records exactly the model-specific sound-oracle construction needed for operational certification.
body.gap: Analytic piecewise-Gaussian formulas have not yet been converted into rational enclosures, an explicit certified modulus, and finite checkable evaluation witnesses.
body.consumer: Once discharged, this target will supply the oracle required by the conditional certificate and regret theorems.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct, from the supplied rational interval name and the piecewise-Gaussian Poisson-energy formulas, a sound rational objective oracle with an explicit compact-uniform modulus and finite checkable witnesses for every interval and point evaluation.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen core proves analytic diffusion and energy formulas but contains no validated rational enclosures for Gaussian normalization and tail terms, no interval treatment of the square-root energy composition and normal quantile, and no explicit rational derivative or Lipschitz bound from which the oracle-width contract follows.  Taking the oracle contract as a premise would assume precisely this crux.
obligation.attempted: Compact-uniform diffusion-energy convergence and analytic continuity were examined, but neither supplies low-level rational evaluation witnesses or an explicit certified modulus.  The logically separate branch-and-bound implication was completed under a supplied sound oracle.
obligation.partial_result:
The model-specific construction is not obtained from the frozen primitives.  The proved generic theorem shows that any supplied sound \((L_J,\mathfrak O)\) yields a terminating rational certificate with
\[
 L_\epsilon\leq\inf_{|\gamma|\leq G}J(p,\gamma)
 \leq J(p,\gamma_\epsilon)\leq U_\epsilon,
 \qquad U_\epsilon-L_\epsilon\leq\epsilon,
\]
and Theorem \(\mathrm{finite\mbox{-}design\mbox{-}regret}\) transfers that conditional guarantee to \(J_N\) with an additional \(o(1)\) term.  No unconditional machine-checkable staffing recommendation follows until rational enclosures, an explicit uniform modulus, and finite evaluation witnesses for the piecewise-Gaussian Poisson energies are constructed and verified.
